description: ut-thesis v3.1.8 (2024/07/26, CTAN and MiKTeX), the University of Toronto thesis class built on book; one column, with the class's default options. The preamble gives the SGS title-page metadata (\degree, \department, \gradyear) neutral sample values in place of the class's '(degree)' placeholders. It also makes \and a comma, because the class's own \maketitle and abstract print \@author inside a center environment with no tabular, so the kernel's \and (which runs \end{tabular}...\begin{tabular}) would fail with several authors.
